page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 52 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 52 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps to handle inter-instance and external communications.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and the absence of hyperthreading, this instance offers predictable compute performance. The resource distribution aligns with general-purpose workloads, in-memory caching systems, and database applications that benefit from dedicated physical cores and a balanced memory-to-core ratio without the overhead of shared threads.
